guesses.breed: Domestic Shorthair (brown mackerel tabby with white)
guesses.reason: Short dense coat with dark brown-black mackerel striping on a gray-brown agouti base, the classic forehead 'M', and white chest and paws point to a random-bred tabby-and-white.
A warm orange-tan patch on the hind leg and rusty tones around the muzzle suggest a hint of patched tabby (torbie) coloring.
The tabby pattern is reminiscent of an American Shorthair, but the slender kitten build and large ears are more typical of a domestic mix.

breed.appearance: A slim young kitten with a short, dense brown mackerel tabby coat: dark brown-black stripes over a gray-brown agouti base, a crisp 'M' on the forehead, dark lines running from the outer corners of the eyes, and bold barring on the front legs. She has a white chin, bib, and chest plus white mittens on her paws, a small warm orange-tan patch on her hind haunch, and rusty-tan shading around the muzzle and brow. Her large, upright, pointed ears are pinkish inside, her round eyes are olive-green with hazel tones, her nose is brick-pink outlined in dark, and she wears a light blue collar.
breed.fun_fact: Tabby cats like Veronica Lake wear a built-in 'M' on their foreheads, so every one comes with its own little monogram!
